title: Z8 dynamic verification criteria
note: A criterion that was not exercised reports NOT_EXERCISED. It never reports PASS.

criteria.title: every place that carries a count agrees with the extent it describes
criteria.note: Emu-side counterpart of the count-source gate: a build that raises one source and leaves the backing table alone walks one entry too far.

criteria.title: no guest access to a poisoned or out-of-envelope region
criteria.note: A one-entry overrun lands on padding and stays invisible unless a live or poisoned object sits there.

criteria.title: declared reject paths reject, and nothing unmodeled is accepted
criteria.note: Silent all-pass and silent all-skip are both defects; the run must show the rejections it declares.

criteria.title: no crash, diagnostic dump or restart loop in the observed window
criteria.note: A crash in the changed run and not in its control condemns the variable; a crash in both condemns the scenario.
